notes.title: Comit Legends is Out Now!
notes.content:
Comit Legends is now available! The game is a remake compilation of all 5 Comit the Astrodian games built on a new engine.

Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826000/Comit_Legends/

OVERVIEW:
Game Type: Platformer

Comit Legends is a remake of the first five Comit games, built from the ground up with a new engine. Replay Comit's fight against the evil space pirate Krater and the universe conquering leader of the Star Knights, Cosmo Knight. Each game will feature a revamped story as well as level layouts being remixed rather than being a straight copy of the original games.

This game includes remakes of all 5 original Comit games all in one game.

STORY:
[u][b]Comit the Astrodian (2016)[/b][/u]
The evil half cyborg space pirate, Krater, has unleashed his robotic army on the galaxy in a campaign of stealing all the riches. The Galactic Council has
failed to stop his onslaught and now only one Astrodian Warrior, Comit, is all that remain between Krater and the robbery of every system's resources.

[u][b]Comit the Astrodian 2 (2017)[/b][/u]
Comit must once stop the evil half cybord space pirate, Krater, from robbing the riches of every system. This time around Krater has upgraded all his gear
and is coming full force for everything. Comit must utilize the power of the Star Crystals to stop Krater once and for all.

[u][b]Comit the Astrodian 3 (2018)[/b][/u]
The powerful Star Knights were unleashed upon the galaxy in search of the Star Crystals that were used to stop the evil half cyborg space pirate, Krater. Comit with the help of his new ally Jupi, but must stop the Star Knight's and their terrifying leader, Cosmo Knight.

[u][b]Comit in Cosmo Knight's Revenge (2019)[/b][/u]
Cosmo Knight is back for revenge, and he is focused on taking down Comit the Astrodian at all costs. Comit & Jupi must survive this all-out attack being led by Cosmo Knight's newest Star Knight, the mysterious Astro Knight.

[u][b]Comit in Krater Returns (2019)[/b][/u]
The evil half cyborg space pirate, Krater, has escaped from Planet Prison and it is up to Comit to stop him. With the Star Crystals now in his sights, Krater plans on rebuilding his army and pillaging the galaxy.

notes.title: Zahalia: The Curse of Zezor - OUT NOW
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636990/Zahalia_The_Curse_of_Zezor/

ABOUT THIS GAME
Description:

Zahalia is a top-down action-rpg with item collection and dungeon exploring. Take back the 7 Crystals from the traitor Zezor and stop General Skull Knight
from invading Zahalia. Explore to find new items to allow you to have access to more of the map and gain new abilities.

Story:
The traitor wizard has stolen the 7 Crystals that power the great seal and prevent otherworldly realms from invading Zahalia. General Skull Knight and his
army of minions now occupy Zahalia. The Empress Vera has summoned a hero from beyond who once stopped Zezor thousands of years ago. Can he stop the
vile wizard once more.
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
MINIMUM:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 7/8/10 x64
Processor: Intel Pentium E2200 (2 * 2200)
Memory: 2 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce 9600 GS / Radeon HD 4670
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 150 MB available space
Additional Notes: Gamepad Recommended
RECOMMENDED:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

notes.title: The State of LunarCore Games
notes.content:
As of now LunarCore Games is going on indefinite hiatus. The stress of making games has become overwhelming and not worth the health issues that come with it. This may be a possible retirement from making games as I am seeking new ventures that are less stressful. My games will remain on the store for now at the very minimum price but I won't be making any new games anytime soon if ever. Thanks for playing what was made.

-LunarCore

notes.title: Patch coming this weekend
notes.content: I've had trouble getting this game and Cosmic Bounty patched because the computer I developed them on died and my new computer doesn't like GMS1 which was used to make them. I was running on Windows 8 while the new one runs on Windows 10 and have been getting hair pulling problems. This week I did manage to get some work done finally which includes a fix to the achievements not working. I still need to do work on the key mapping so for the meantime I just have a WSAD and Arrow Keys system working simultaneously. I haven't fixed the dungeon spawn problem yet. I thought it was fixed with the first patch but errors were still reported. It is on the agenda for fixes this week.
